property_summary: A second deposit of 1 wei by the same account, after an initial deposit of 1 wei causes the balance to reach exactly type(uint256).max-1; the original assert rejects the overflow (revert), the buggy require allows it (no revert).
change_summary: Replace assert(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value > balances[msg.sender]) with require(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value >= balances[msg.sender]) to allow overflow and change deposit result.
